note: Decision records (roadmap step 3) by the Card's maintainers. The local corner radius is rejected. The selectable Card is left undecided on purpose, so the design stays not yet adoptable. The real Fluent 2 web kit draws the header quick action and the footer by default, so Shop's use of them is not an override and needs no decision. The deciders are the demo's placeholder owners, not real Fluent teams. Add or change a call with `civic decide`.

decisions.title: Reject Shop's local corner radius
decisions.rationale: Reject. The contract takes corner radius from the shape token, and a local 20 breaks it on every platform. Shop design reverts the radius, and the Card reads Awaiting adoption until the file matches.
